title: Navimower 0.4.5-beta7

## ZoneLedger shadow-state field test

This beta introduces the first low-risk migration step toward a single authoritative per-zone state model. The existing production zone/progress pipeline remains fully authoritative for sensors, automations and Map API output; the new ZoneLedger runs beside it only for comparison diagnostics.

### Canonical per-zone reducer

- Add a pure `ZoneLedger` reducer for retained per-zone cycle identity, vendor coverage, mowed area, reset confirmation and completion state.
- Keep fresh `get-path-info-time.partitionPercentage` coverage as the canonical numeric input for the shadow model.
- Keep MQTT active-zone/work progress as task context and reset corroboration instead of treating it as a competing retained zone-coverage source.
- Retain same-cycle progress monotonically when a stale vendor sample regresses, while allowing a confirmed new vendor cycle, geometry change or repeated low reset sample to start a new cycle.
- Separate retained zone state from whole-task progress and task mowed-area resolution.

### Shadow comparison only

- Run ZoneLedger after the existing completion and vendor-progress semantics so it sees the exact values currently published by the legacy model.
- Do **not** replace `zone_states`, public `totals`, sensors or Map API values in this beta.
- Publish compact legacy-vs-ledger comparison diagnostics including overall `match`, per-zone coverage/mowed-area differences, map/task total differences and recent cycle events.
- Catch shadow-reducer failures so a ZoneLedger error cannot make the integration unavailable or alter the public legacy state.

### Regression coverage

- Add a 15-case transition table plus focused tests for sticky progress, stale vendor data, confirmed low resets, MQTT contradiction guards, geometry resets, 100% completion, explicit reset acknowledgement, weighted map totals and task-vs-zone progress separation.
- Existing compile, integration regression, HACS and hassfest validation remain part of the normal release gate.

### What to test

After upgrading, use Home Assistant **Download diagnostics** after normal mowing activity. The useful field-test data is under the ZoneLedger shadow comparison in the retained totals diagnostics: `match`, `zone_differences`, `metric_differences` and recent cycle events. A mismatch is expected to be diagnostic only and must not change the visible map, zone sensors or mower behavior.

No Navimower Map Card update is required for this beta.
